thread:
maya: Starting a thread — noticed noisy debug logs during SDK onboarding in sampleapp. When new users run quickstart, they get DEBUG spam and raw request IDs in logs even when they set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info. Anyone seen this?

alex: hmm, haven't seen in prod but repro'd locally. looks like our log hook initialises after the OTEL hook so redaction hasn't run on early logs. :thinking_face: 

sam: can you paste the logs and env? I suspect the npm package autoinit race. 

maya: log+env below:
```
$ REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info node sampleapp/index.js
[2026-03-22T14:12:34.123Z] INFO  server Starting up
[2026-03-22T14:12:34.124Z] DEBUG transport RequestID=req_abc123 request.start handler=auth
[2026-03-22T14:12:34.125Z] DEBUG transport RequestID=req_abc123 headers={"authorization":"Bearer sk-live-xxx"}
```
Note the auth token in headers printed before redaction.

jen: ugh. that matches a race we fixed in go runtime last quarter. Node side still has autoinit order: logger -> transport -> otel. If transport logs during init, redaction hook hasn't been registered. 

alex: quick workaround: set REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTOLOG=1 before starting, then call require('@redwood/sdk').init({registerRedaction:true}) after otel init in your app. Or add this in sampleapp quickstart:
```
process.env.REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTOLOG = '1';
const otel = require('@opentelemetry/api');
require('@redwood/sdk').init({registerRedaction:true});
require('./server');
```

maya: repro'd workaround, thanks. Can we patch SDK to defer transport logs until redaction hook is installed? 

sam: opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/456 — adds ordering guard and tests. left a FIXME about backwards compat. 

ci-bot: build passed for PR 456 :white_check_mark: 

jen: let's include a one-liner in sampleapp README and add a telemetry test in CI to catch regresses. 

maya: agreed. I'll update the quickstart. 

alex: created a follow-up ticket in Jira: INF-2334 to track rollout and changelog entry. 

maya: thanks everyone, closing the loop. :thumbsup:
